Davlat mulkini ijaraga berish tartibiga: Amendments and additions to the procedure for leasing state property
Vazirlar Mahkamasining 2023 yil 14 dekab: Paragraph 38 of Annex 1 to Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 563 of 13 October 2026 introduced the following amendments and additions to the Regulation on the Lease of State Property approved by Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 660 of 14 December 2023:
Ijara shartnomasi shartlarini, shu jumla: Tenants who have failed to meet the terms of a lease agreement, including rent payments, three or more times in a row are barred from taking part in auctions for the lease of state property for one year.
Chetlatilgan ijarachilar reyestri «onlin: The register of barred tenants is maintained in the «online-ijara.uz» information system and integrated with the «E-auksion» electronic trading platform.
Ijarachi reyestrga kiritilgan sanadan bo: A tenant is removed from the register automatically 12 months after the date of inclusion.
Yuqori texnologiyali mahsulotlar yaratuv: Businesses that create high-technology products may be granted state property of up to 10,000 square metres for free use directly for 5 years and, if the terms of the agreement are met, may buy it directly at its appraised value.

Director of the Center for the efficient use of state facilities,
to the public and the system's staff
on combating corruption

Davlat mulki obyektlaridan samarali foyd: Our Center bears great responsibility for constantly supporting businesses and for leasing them state-owned property for production and services.
Markazimiz faoliyati halollik, shaffofli: Our Center's work rests on the principles of integrity, transparency and accountability. We pursue a policy of “zero tolerance” for corruption, and this is not merely a slogan but our everyday way of working.
Davlat boshqaruvining koʻplab tarmoqlari: Like many branches of public administration, the Center's system has taken a number of steps to prevent corruption, digitalise its work and ensure openness.

davlat koʻchmas mulk obyektlarini xususi: a system has been introduced for leasing state real estate to the private sector through auctions, distributing rental income automatically and collecting rent receipts.
Markaz tizimida korrupsiyaga qarshi kura: a unit responsible for combating corruption has been set up in the Center's system; cases of corruption are studied systematically, and concrete measures are being taken to eliminate the causes and conditions that give rise to them;
Shu bilan birga, xodimlar oʻrtasida halo: At the same time, explanatory and preventive work aimed at strengthening the principles of integrity and openness among staff is carried out regularly.
Taʼkidlash joizki, Markaz tizimida “korr: It should be noted that we will consistently continue practical efforts to create a “corruption-free” environment in the Center's system and to put a complete end to bureaucracy and conflicts of interest.
Aziz yurtdoshlar, sohaning fidoyi zahmat: Dear compatriots, devoted workers of the sector!
Halollik — bizning eng katta kuchimiz, s: Integrity is our greatest strength, transparency is our way of working, and trust is our greatest capital!
Har bir qadam ortida xalq manfaati turis: The people's interest must stand behind every step; every action of ours must be responsible, and every process open and fair!
manfaatlar toʻqnashuviga yoʻl qoʻymaslik: not to allow conflicts of interest;
elektron auksion va raqamli nazorat orqa: to strengthen transparency through electronic auctions and digital control;
jamoada halollik madaniyatini kuchaytiri: to strengthen the culture of integrity in the team.
Shunday ekan, Markaz tizimidagi har bir: I would therefore like to stress once again that every employee of the Center's system is responsible for preventing and putting an end to corruption in their work.
Markaz tizimida mehnat qilayotgan barcha: I call on all staff working in the Center's system to be uncompromising towards corruption in any form, and to perform their duties honestly and impartially.

Maqsad — davlat mulkidan foydalanish sam: The aim is to make the use of state property more efficient, to deepen realtors' professional knowledge, and to better inform citizens and entrepreneurs.
Seminarlar, treninglar va amaliy mashgʻu: Holding seminars, trainings and practical sessions;
Davlat mulkini ijaraga olish, sotib olis: Preparing materials on renting and buying state property and taking part in electronic auctions;
Ijara imtiyozlari va shartlarini tushunt: Explaining rental benefits and lease terms;
Rieltorlar malakasini oshirish va uslubi: Professional development and methodological support for realtors;
Davlat mulki obyektlari bilan tanishish: Organising visits to state properties and discussing practical issues together.
Ushbu hamkorlik keng jamoatchilikning da: This cooperation will help raise public awareness of the opportunities to rent and buy state property, and develop realtors' professional work in this field.
